registered_hypotheses.statement: Delta(s) is negative with CI excluding zero for at least one model at s>=2 (excess horizon degradation beyond the independent-error prediction)
The positional hazard h(u) of the first unrecovered critical error increases with normalized position u after controlling for task random effects
theta_self, the share of Delta removed by history scrubbing, is greater than zero with CI excluding zero
registered_hypotheses.note: DIRECTIONALLY CONTESTED IN PRINT. Sinha et al. support a positive effect; ChainSWE reports Seq 36.5% vs Seq+Mem 36.9%, i.e. approximately zero transcript effect once environment state carries the damage. This hypothesis can genuinely fail.

registered_hypotheses.statement: theta_state, the share removed by oracle state refresh, is greater than zero with CI excluding zero
registered_hypotheses.note: ChainSWE's Oracle-vs-Seq contrast (58.9% vs 36.5%) is coarse prior evidence that this is the larger of the two.

registered_hypotheses.statement: pi(e,u) is near 1 for state-changing tool errors and near 0 for read-only errors, with disjoint CIs
theta_self declines with model scale and under reasoning-on
registered_hypotheses.note: Sinha et al. report thinking mitigates self-conditioning. Scoped to 4B-30B on this hardware.

registered_hypotheses.statement: Events labelled catastrophic forgetting are substantially removed by history scrubbing while the constraint remains in context, i.e. they are better explained as self-conditioning than as memory failure
registered_hypotheses.note: HORIZON's own definition, verified verbatim, states the constraint 'is still present in the context but not attended to during later reasoning' and lists Memory Limitation as a separate category. This is the headline non-obvious result if it holds.

registered_hypotheses.statement: Reconciliation of the Sinha/ChainSWE conflict: self-conditioning is visible at step granularity and at high u, but is masked at coarse stage granularity and absorbed by environment state when errors leave a state trace
registered_hypotheses.note: Pre-registered directional hypothesis; sub-hypotheses H-A (dominated when environment absorbs), H-B (granularity), H-C (position-dependent) in docs/phase0_verification.md section 3

Evaluation is FINAL state-based unit tests only. Intermediate stage checkpoints must be CONSTRUCTED by decomposing evaluation_code. Anticipated by audit task T1.4.

outstanding_blockers.blocker: Preliminary signal that the horizon gap on AppWorld may not be negative
outstanding_blockers.detail: AppWorld reports GPT-4 at 48.7% Task Goal Completion vs 21.0% Scenario Goal Completion. If a scenario averages ~3 tasks, an independence null would predict SGC of roughly 0.49^3 = 0.115, versus 0.21 observed - i.e. BETTER than independent. This is a crude comparison (tasks within a scenario are not equal-difficulty independent draws, and TGC is averaged across scenarios of differing size) and must not be over-read, but it is a directional hint against H1 that was recorded BEFORE running anything.
